summary: Built a deterministic fully-specified scenario engine with latent covered-disc values, proved it trajectory-identical to the base engine over 218,470 moves, implemented an exact clairvoyant solver with a transposition table, minted a labelled 128-scenario suite and a 256-position sparse probe, and produced the first measurement of whether a board clear is reachable at all under perfect knowledge.
validationPerformed: Parity gate: 4,096 seeds by 2 deterministic policies, 218,470 moves, 0 mismatches on boards, scores, wave lists and terminal flags, plus 20,000 random-board checks of the paired gravity and rise transforms.
Solver self-tested on hand-constructed positions; all 128 suite scenarios solved exactly at horizon 9 and re-solving reproduced every optimum bit-for-bit.
limitations: Recorded by the coordinator on the delegated agent's behalf; the agent had no write access to research/ and did not review this transcription.
The latent reveal source has different dynamics from the base engine by design, so its scores are not bit-comparable to base-engine runs.
Horizon 9 is itself binding, so the zero board-clear rate on realistic boards is partly a horizon statement.
The suite is not yet validated as a predictor of whole-game strength and cannot be cited as strength evidence.
